evidence.forced_actor_and_constraint: PASS. New York Fed operating policy states that primary dealers are expected to bid in every Treasury auction for at least their pro-rata share of the offered amount at reasonably competitive prices, with continued dealer status subject to ongoing business standards.
evidence.dealer_population_pit: PASS. The New York Fed publishes the current primary-dealer list together with dated additions, removals and name changes, allowing historical dealer-count reconstruction at an auction date.
evidence.auction_clock_and_offered_amount: PASS. Treasury auction announcements publish the security, offered amount, auction date, issue date, maturity and closing times; TreasuryDirect's Auction Search exposes historical announcement/results data and downloadable CSV/JSON/TSV/XML.
evidence.pre_outcome_expression_feasibility: PASS_BOUNDED. A protocol can be frozen before outcome access using only the auction schedule, security/tenor, offered amount and dealer count. The first test must use a separately frozen executable duration proxy and cannot condition entry on auction results, high yield, bid-to-cover, dealer take-down or post-auction prices.
evidence.economic_claim_level: RESTRICTED. The documents establish a participation constraint and predictable supply event, not a guaranteed dealer inventory shock or profitable concession. Direct/indirect demand, when-issued risk transfer, hedging and competition may absorb the effect.
evidence.data_leakage: CONTROLLED_IF_PROTOCOL_FREEZES. Auction results and any post-close/post-auction observations are outcome data and must remain unopened until the exact protocol, sample, costs, capacity, multiplicity and decision rule are frozen.

claim_restriction: Validated only: U.S. Treasury auctions impose a dated participation expectation on primary dealers and create a pre-announced supply/distribution event. Not validated: dealer net inventory magnitude, auction concession, reversal, alpha, profitability, or capacity.
required_test_design: freeze exactly one tenor family before outcomes (initial candidate: 10-year nominal note auctions)
freeze an executable duration proxy and exact entry/exit clocks using only information available before each event
exclude any rule that uses auction-result fields to decide whether to trade
declare matched benchmark/control, sample window, missing-data policy and macro-event confounder policy
declare cost and capacity assumptions before outcome access
count this as one observed trial in the Treasury-auction mechanism family and declare multiplicity handling
